definitions.explanation: Words or manner of speaking that invites being disliked; speaking in a way that annoys or antagonizes others.

examples.japanese: {憎|にく}まれ{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{憎|にく}まれ{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧{皆|みんな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怒|おこ}らせた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: He made sarcastic remarks again and angered everyone.

examples.japanese: {憎|にく}まれ{口|ぐち}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{嫌|きら}われる→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you keep making harsh remarks, people will really start to dislike you.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {憎|にく}まれ{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ - to make spiteful/sarcastic remarks

PROVERB:
- ⟦{憎|にく}まれ→憎む：00318_nikumu⟧っ{子|こ}⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はばかる - The hated child prospers in the world (troublemakers often succeed)

NOTE ON CONSTRUCTION:
⟦{憎|にく}まれ→憎む：00318_nikumu⟧ (passive of ⟦{憎|にく}む→憎む：00318_nikumu⟧ "to hate") + {口|ぐち} (mouth/speech) = literally "speech that makes one hated"

- ⟦{嫌味|いやみ}→嫌味：07024_iyami⟧ - snide remark, sarcasm
